onboarding.title:
Bins out.
On time.
onboarding.body: Pickup reminders for your address in Vilnius, Kaunas and Mažeikiai districts.
onboarding.featureReminder: Get a reminder the evening before
onboarding.disclaimer: Unofficial app made by volunteers. Dates come from the schedules published by UAB „Nemenčinės komunalininkas“, UAB „Nemėžio komunalininkas“, UAB „Kauno švara“ and UAB „Telšių regiono atliekų tvarkymo centras“ and may contain mistakes.

setup.locationHint: Let us find your place, or search for your village or town.
setup.locationNone: Nothing found. Only places in Vilnius, Kaunas and Mažeikiai districts that we have schedules for are listed.
setup.locationKaunasCity: Kaunas city isn't covered, only Kaunas district (Kauno r.).
setup.manualLink: Can't find it? Pick schedule rows by hand
setup.streetHint: Pickup days in {{place}} depend on the street.
setup.housingHint: {{place}} has separate schedules for houses and apartment buildings.
setup.houseHint: Your own bin by the road
setup.chooseHint: Several rows mention {{place}}. Pick the one that includes your address.
setup.useLocationHint: Finds the nearest address. Your location never leaves your phone.
setup.foundStreetUnsure: Your location is approximate, so you'll confirm the street next.
setup.foundStreetFar: The nearest address we know is more than 100 m away, so you'll pick the street next.
setup.locationDenied: Location access is off. Search for your place below, or allow location in the phone's settings.
setup.locationUnavailable: Couldn't get your location. Search for your place below.
setup.locationOffline: Couldn't download the address list. Check your internet connection.
setup.locationFar: There's no address we have a schedule for near you (Vilnius, Kaunas and Mažeikiai districts). If you're not at home, search for your place below.
setup.locationServicesOff: Location is turned off on your phone. Turn it on and try again, or search for your place below.
setup.addressHint: Pickup days in {{place}} depend on the address.
setup.addressesFailed: Couldn't download the addresses. Check your internet connection.

select.title: {{kind}}: your area
select.hint: Search for your village, town or street, then pick the row that includes your address.
select.noResults: Nothing found. Try a shorter word, without the ending.
select.noDates: No exact dates in the schedule: {{note}}

home.nothingUpcoming: No upcoming pickups in the published schedule yet. We'll check for a new schedule automatically.
home.nothingForKind: No upcoming {{kind}} pickups in the published schedule.
home.placeMissing: Your place changed in the new schedule. Please choose it again.
home.choosePending: Tell us which {{kind}} schedule is yours.
home.noteOnly: {{kind}}: the schedule only says “{{note}}”, so we can't send reminders for it.
home.nextNotAnnounced: {{kind}}: the last pickup was on {{date}}. The next date isn't published yet; it will appear here as soon as the new schedule is out.
home.notificationsOff: Notifications are off, so you won't get reminders.
home.refreshFailed: Couldn't check for a new schedule. Showing the saved one.
home.noReminder: Reminders are off for this pickup
home.staleData: The schedule of {{company}} couldn't be checked for changes since {{date}}. If the company has changed it, the dates here may be out of date.
home.checkOverdue: The app hasn't been able to check for a new schedule since {{date}}. Connect to the internet and pull down to refresh.

settings.title: Settings
settings.disclaimer: This app is provided free of charge, as is, without any warranty. The authors are not responsible for missed or wrong reminders, or for any consequences of relying on them. It is not affiliated with UAB „Nemenčinės komunalininkas“, UAB „Nemėžio komunalininkas“, UAB „Kauno švara“, UAB „Ekonovus“, UAB „Telšių regiono atliekų tvarkymo centras“, UAB „Ecoservice“ or UAB „Virginijus ir Ko“.
settings.perKindHint: To be reminded of one waste type differently, or not at all, tap it under “Your place”.
settings.exportHint: Saves the pickup dates known now as a calendar file (.ics), with your reminders as alarms. Your calendar won't follow later changes, so add it again when a new schedule is published.

notifications.refreshBody: Open the app so it can load the next schedule.

errors.loadFailed: Couldn't load the schedule. Check your internet connection.
errors.unsupported: The schedule format has changed. Please update the app.

feedback.title: Help & feedback
feedback.githubNote: Opens a form on GitHub (a free account is needed). Nothing is sent until you submit it.
feedback.wrongDates: Dates look wrong? Let us know
feedback.area: Ask for my area to be added

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: The app ran into an unexpected error. Try again, or report it so we can fix it.
crash.lastTitle: The app closed unexpectedly last time. Would you like to report it? The report contains technical details only.

custom.title: My schedule
custom.notListed: My place isn't listed: set my own schedule
custom.setupHint: Tell us when each container is collected and we'll remind you. You'll find the days on your bin, in your contract or on your waste company's website.
custom.monthlyNote: Monthly pickups keep the same weekday, e.g. the 2nd Tuesday of each month.
custom.needOne: Set at least one schedule to continue.
custom.exceptionsHint: Holiday week? Skip the usual date with ×, then add the day it moved to.

manage.useOfficial: Use the official schedule for my place
manage.statusNone: Not in the official schedule for your place
manage.statusPending: Several schedule rows match your place
manage.hint: Changes apply to your reminders right away.
manage.remindersHint: Glass is collected only a few times a year, so it's easy to forget: give it an extra reminder. Or turn reminders off for a type you put out anyway.

kauno.ekonovus: Collected by UAB „Ekonovus“: see its schedule

guide.title: Which bin?
guide.subtitle: Search for an item to see where it goes.
guide.noResults: Nothing found. Try another word or browse a category.
guide.general: General rules. Choose your place to see what's collected there.
guide.notCollected: {{kind}}: not collected at your place. Instead:
guide.disclaimer: Rules can differ between waste companies and change over time. Your collector's official page has the final word.

dest.depositHint: Return packaging with the deposit mark empty and uncrushed to a return machine in a shop and get 10 ct back.
dest.shopHint: Shops that sell batteries, bulbs and electronics take old ones back free of charge.
dest.siteHint: The regional waste centre's site takes it from residents free of charge, within yearly limits.
dest.greenSiteHint: The regional waste centre's composting site takes garden waste from residents free of charge.
dest.textileHint: Clean and dry textiles, in a tied bag.
dest.pharmacyHint: Any pharmacy takes unwanted and expired medicines free of charge.
dest.compostHint: Raw fruit and vegetable scraps, coffee, tea and garden waste. No meat, fish or cooked food.
dest.orangeBagHint: In Vilnius district, put food waste in a free orange bag (from eldership offices and bulky waste sites), tie it and put it in the mixed waste container.

calendar.noPickupsMonth: No pickups this month in the published schedule.

places.title: Your places
places.hint: Every saved place gets reminders, e.g. home and a summer house. Tap one to see its pickups.
